# Vendored M2000 core

Source: <https://github.com/p2000t/M2000>

The following unmodified files provide the P2000T machine and Z80 core:

- `P2000.c`, `P2000.h`, `SDCart.c`, `SDCart.h`
- `Z80.c`, `Z80.h`, `Z80IO.h`, `Z80Codes.h`, `Z80DAA.h`
- `Default.fnt`

The headless platform callbacks and PNG renderer live in `../../src/main.c`.
